notices.title: Environmental Assessment Certificate Amendment for the Site C Dam Expansion
notices.content: BC Hydro has submitted a proposal to expand the Site C dam generating capacity by adding a 200 MW powerhouse. The capital investment is projected at C$850 million for the expansion phase.

notices.title: Request for Qualifications: Vancouver International Airport Terminal 3 Expansion
notices.content: The Vancouver Airport Authority requests qualifications from qualified design-builder teams for the expansion of the international terminal. The project is estimated at C$1.2 billion.
